newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin up on LME, buying demand.
newsitem.headline: KL tin up on LME, buying demand.

text.p: Malaysia's spot tin price rose 10 cents to 14.65 ringgit ($5.27) a kg on Friday after reacting to an overnight rise on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"The LME ended higher and that was a supportive factor," said a dealer. "Also there was some good buying demand."
Traders said the weak Malaysian ringgit also helped sentiment.
They said the price could still test $15 if sentiment stayed firm in the week ahead.
At Friday's opening, there were buyers for 146 tonnes and sellers for 85 tonnes. Final turnover was 134 tonnes, against 118 on Thursday, and was absorbed by Japanese, European and local interests.
The closing price was at a discount of $15 against the LME from $10 on Thursday, traders said.
